name: Research Notes
description: Structured reading notes — a lead agent, reading coach expert, intensive-notes skill, and a kickoff command.
longDescription: Install a lightweight research-notes suite into your project: a notes-focused orchestrator, a reading-coach expert, the intensive-reading-notes skill, and a /reading-notes command to start a session.

orchestrators.name: Notes Lead
orchestrators.description: Coordinates deep reading and structured note-taking across your library.

experts.name: Reading Notes Coach
experts.description: Shapes reading cards and evidence-tied notes for a scoped paper or section.

skills.name: Research Reading Notes
skills.description: Turn intensive reading into durable, linked project notes.

commands.name: reading-notes
commands.description: Start a structured reading-notes session for selected papers.
